headword: {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}
gloss: local train; train stopping at every station

definitions.gloss: local train; train stopping at every station
definitions.explanation: A train service that stops at every station along its route, as opposed to express or rapid services. Often abbreviated to {各停|かくてい}.

examples.japanese: {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which arrives first, the express or the local?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}しか⟦{走|はし}っていない→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Only local trains are running during this time period.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{各駅|かくえき}→各駅：27449_kakueki⟧ (each station) + ⟦{停車|ていしゃ}→停車：04534_teisha⟧ (stopping). Often abbreviated to ⟦{各停|かくてい}→各停：09214_kakutei⟧ in conversation and on station signage.

TRAIN SERVICE HIERARCHY (slowest to fastest):
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}: local (stops at every station)
- ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧: rapid
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧: express
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take the local train
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go by local train
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}える→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧: to transfer to a local

USAGE:
No extra fare is required for {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}, unlike ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ which often requires a surcharge (⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧).
